>
[Vashu's Ninth Knife](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3150)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #198: No Breath to Cry](/Sources.aspx?ID=224) pg. 77

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+1 striking [ghost touch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2840) [katana](/Weapons.aspx?ID=411)_ is made from a whisker stolen from the king of cats over three hundred years ago by a catfolk rogue named Vashu Vigaru. He sought the magic of the whisker to preternaturally extend his life, and some believe he still lives, having successfully divested himself of the sword to escape the king's wrath in the end.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> (envision);  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** Your turn ends;  **Effect** You extend your senses through the blade, allowing you to react to nearby movement. _Vashu's Ninth Life_	 gains the [parry](/Traits.aspx?ID=667) trait and raises itself into parrying position, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> (envision);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** A portion of the slain creature's life force travels through the blade and into your soul, bolstering your own life. You gain the benefits of the [Diehard](/Feats.aspx?ID=5140) feat for 1 minute. This causes you to die from the dying condition at dying 5 rather than dying 4.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
